passages.title: Bringing New Life to Old Cities
passages.text: As cities age, neighborhoods can become old and lifeless, which may cause citizens to move away. When this happens, a collaboration between the local government and citizens is an effective way to revitalize the area.

For years, the neighborhood was known for its high crime rates. Many apartments ①[were] abandoned and then ②[taking] over by people who lived in them illegally. At first, the local government thought that the best solution ③[was] simply to tear the building down. However, ④[having] a limited budget, the government was unable to do so and had to come up with a new plan, ⑤[which] was to sell the empty apartments for one euro each.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?
윗글의 내용을 요약할 때, 빈칸 (1), (2)에 들어갈 말을 쓰시오.
questions.body: As a neighborhood ages, it may become (1) __________ and lose residents. Cooperation between the local government and citizens can help (2) __________ the area.
conditions: 각 빈칸에 한 단어씩 쓸 것.
윗글에 나온 단어를 형태 변경 없이 쓸 것.

questions.stem: 윗글에 나온 문장이 되도록 [보기]의 어구를 배열하시오.
conditions: [보기]의 모든 어구를 한 번씩 사용할 것.
단어를 추가하거나 형태를 바꾸지 말 것.
